configuration.candidate_formula: On LIRF rows with an NM clock and supported connected route: v7 + 0.5 * candidate_weight * (new_airport_prediction - frozen_v7_airport_prediction). Every other prediction equals v7 exactly.
configuration.fit_route: All original LIRF clock-present fitting rows, including geometry-missing rows. Same October stopping sets; no December.
configuration.prior_information: The v7 and source/geometry audit results are known. LIRF supported historical coverage is 98.32-100%. LFPG failed endpoint controls and is excluded from new geometry models. Reporting audit supports no additional clock repair. No Rome geometry model has yet been fitted or scored.
configuration.refit_policy: Only if a candidate qualifies after both platform verifiers, refit its one new LIRF airport learner on the same January-November clock-present IDs protected from all December flight groups. Freeze trees by ties-to-even rounded median of its two October stopping counts. Reuse v7 prediction and all other components; no stopping set during refit.
configuration.selection: Finish all six native fits and four complete candidate recipes. Require >=0.5% RMSE improvement over v7 on BOTH original complete folds; among eligible candidates choose lowest equal-weight mean relative RMSE, then lexical name. Control must reproduce before selection. No new airport weights or label filters.

control.purpose: Reproduce the frozen v7 LIRF airport component at identical fitting/stopping IDs and settings.

paired_day_reference: v7; inherited helper field names are descriptive only
